title: To Protect and To Serve? Analyzing Entity-Centric Framing of Police Violence
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its framework is designed to measure entity-centric frames (e.g., victim's race, armed status) and issue frames (e.g., legal language, systemic issues) in news coverage of police violence. A quote from a pastor was used as an example of an 'unofficial source' frame, but religious framing itself was not a measured category.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion. A single mention of a pastor's quote is used to exemplify the 'unofficial source' frame, which the paper finds is more likely to be highlighted in left-leaning media. This is a finding about source citation patterns, not about religion's role in framing the issue.
references: A fully scrubbed csv of all of media bias fact check's primary categories.
